b.04dce8fb53:
<h>Hymnus</h>
<c>L</c>auda mater Ecclésia,
Lauda Christi cleméntiam,
Qui septem purgat vítia
Per séptiformem grátiam.

<h>M</h>aría, soror Lázari,
Quæ tot commísit crímina,
Ab ipsa fauce tártari
Redit ad vitæ límina.

<h>P</h>ost fluxæ carnis scándala
Fit ex lebéte phíala
In vas transláta glóriæ
De vase contuméliæ.

<h>Æ</h>gra currit ad médicum
Vas ferens aromáticum
Et a morbo multíplici
Verbo curátur médici.

<h>S</h>urgéntem cum victória
Iesum videt ab ínferis,
Prima merétur gáudia,
Quæ plus ardébat céteris.

<h>U</h>ni Deo sit glória,
Pro multifórmi grátia,
Peccántium qui crímina
Remíttit, et dat prǽmia.
Amen.
b.5afb251d7a:
<h>Hymn</h>
<c>F</c>ather of lights! one glance of thine,
Whose eyes the universe control,
Fills Magdalene with holy love,
And melts the ice within her soul.

<h>H</h>er precious ointment forth she brings
Upon those sacred feet to pour;
She washes them with burning tears,
And with her hair she wipes them o'er.

<h>I</h>mpassioned, to the cross she clings,
Nor fears beside the tomb to stay;
Nor dreads the soldiers' savage mien,
For love has cast all fear away.

<h>O</h> Christ, thou very love itself!
Blest hope of man, through thee forgiven!
So touch our spirits from above,
So purify our souls for heaven.

<h>T</h>o God the Father, with the Son
And Holy Paraclete, with thee,
As evermore hath been before,
Be glory through eternity.
Amen.

<h>Lectio 3</h>

<r>Homilia 25 in Evangelia</r>
